title: Lost Mary Blueberry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary Blueberry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a classic, mouth-watering fusion of popular forest fruits. The profile opens with the deep, mellow sweetness of ripe Blueberries, providing a smooth and satisfying fruit foundation. This is perfectly complemented by the bright, sharp sweetness of fresh Raspberries on the exhale, creating a balanced and consistent flavour that is light, juicy, and perfect for all-day enjoyment. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Lost Mary Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Lost Mary Nic Salts collection delivers the same intense and globally popular flavours that made their single-use devices famous, now in a convenient 10ml refillable format. Beyond the balanced berry blend of Blueberry Raspberry, vapers can explore other vibrant options within the range, such as the bright, zesty Orange Juice or the crisp Double Apple. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a premium, flavour-packed experience in a more cost-effective format. Compatible with refillable pod vape or vape starter kit UK devices for smooth hits.
